notes.title: Update Announcement
notes.notes:
Hello, players.

On 4/12 we updated a version with the following fixes.
1. Delete the Chinese in the installation folder and replace it with "Takame Girls-Initiating Station PLUS".
2. Use the built-in fonts to fix the problem that some players can't display some text or some fonts are not uniform.
3. Fix the bug that the left mouse button may crash when clicked continuously in some cases.

This week we will discuss solutions to the following problems: operating systems other than "Traditional Chinese, Taiwan" cannot start the game.
Players who encounter this problem are patient. Thank you.
